content: Letter 11, to Amīr Sayyid Zayn al-ʿĀbidīn (Junābādī, sayyid and vizier prominent in the dīvān under Temür and early Shāhrukh, per MK's footnote): Ibn Turka appreciates the amir's protection of the weak and oppressed, for which religious leaders and scholars universally love him (TMN/MS p. 7).
